description: P8 deterministic evaluation corpus. The runner creates these requirements through the real P3/P5 APIs, then derives design coverage, impact, classification, issue and supplement metrics against the committed ground truth. Titles are the stable contract with the deterministic fake LLM (scripts/fake-llm.cjs); change the corpus version whenever a title, scenario or ground-truth expectation changes.
